curriculum.title: Generative AI Foundations for Leaders
points: AI Landscape and Foundations for leaders: Demystifying the Hype
Generative AI explained: what it is & isn't
Core models and capabilities simplified (LLMs, multimodal,  diffusion)
Emerging trends and disruption patterns across industries

curriculum.title: Generative AI for Productivity & Automation
points: Accelerating individual and team productivity (reports,  analysis,  summarization)
Communication and collaboration workflows (presentations, emails,  briefs)
Multimodal content creation (text,  image, video, voice)
Human–AI collaboration Best Practices

curriculum.title: Building Generative AI Solutions Without Coding
points: Introduction to no/low-code platforms (Knime, Zapier, Bubble, LangChain Lite)
Creating AI assistants and enterprise bots
Automating workflows with GenAI
Hands-on prototyping of simple business applications

curriculum.title: Agentic AI for Autonomous Systems
points: Understanding agentic AI and autonomous decision-making systems
Designing and managing autonomous workflows
Use cases across operations, service, and product innovation

curriculum.title: Business Transformation with Generative AI
points: Function-level applications across marketing, sales,  HR, finance, and operations
Integrating applications into enterprise operating models
Redesigning value chains and customer journeys
Building AI-enabled growth strategies

curriculum.title: Generative AI Strategy & Roadmapping
points: Identifying high-value GenAI opportunities and low-hanging fruits
Building pilots vs long-term bets
Aligning GenAI initiatives to business strategy and goals
Designing ROI frameworks, cost/revenue levers, TCO,  and measurement
Investment decisions: build vs buy,  partnerships, and CFO considerations

curriculum.title: Scaling, Governance & The Future of Work
points: AI governance, risks and compliance, and regulatory frameworks (including introduction to DPDP) for responsible adoption
Enterprise-wide scaling: CoEs,  Federated vs Centralized models, Change management
Workforce reskilling,  leadership, and new organizational roles
Cultural readiness and human–AI collaboration models

curriculum.title: Capstone Project
points: Leaders will identify, prototype, and demonstrate two high-impact GenAI use cases within their business function—such as automating customer proposals, summarizing reports, or generating marketing content. They'll evaluate ROI, design prompt workflows, and present a working demo that showcases measurable productivity or innovation gains within their department.
80+ Hours of Live Classes
6 Career Sessions by Accredian
